messages.subject: ranef and pcountOpen
parts:
Hello Unmarkers,

It seems that the ranef function doesn't work with pcountOpen objects when dynamics are set to "gompertz" or "ricker".  I ran into this issue with my own data, and then checked it with an Alder Flycatcher example that I found on a workshop on this forum. Here is the output I get when running a model from the workshop and others with the dynamics changed:

>fm4

Call:
pcountOpen(lambdaformula = ~woody, gammaformula = ~1, omegaformula = ~1, 
    pformula = ~date + time, data = alfl.umf, K = 30, dynamics = "autoreg")

Abundance:
            Estimate     SE    z  P(>|z|)
(Intercept)    1.670 0.4894 3.41 6.44e-04
woody          0.401 0.0914 4.39 1.13e-05

Recruitment:
 Estimate   SE      z P(>|z|)
   -0.702 1.81 -0.387   0.699

Apparent Survival:
 Estimate   SE     z P(>|z|)
     1.72 7.07 0.244   0.807

Detection:
            Estimate     SE     z  P(>|z|)
(Intercept)   -2.539 0.5204 -4.88 1.07e-06
date          -0.520 0.1126 -4.62 3.82e-06
time          -0.135 0.0967 -1.40 1.62e-01

AIC: 535.2716 


> re = ranef(fm4)
> re
, , Year1

           Mean Mode 2.5% 97.5%
 [1,]  5.368021    5    2    10
 [2,]  6.533208    6    4    10   …… deleted the rest so the post wouldn't be several pages long.


> (fm4 <- pcountOpen(~woody, ~1, ~1, ~date+time, alfl.umf, K=30,
+                    dynamics="gompertz"))

Call:
pcountOpen(lambdaformula = ~woody, gammaformula = ~1, omegaformula = ~1, 
    pformula = ~date + time, data = alfl.umf, K = 30, dynamics = "gompertz")

Abundance:
            Estimate    SE    z  P(>|z|)
(Intercept)    1.025 0.266 3.85 1.17e-04
woody          0.474 0.116 4.07 4.64e-05

Growth Rate:
 Estimate    SE    z  P(>|z|)
    0.892 0.228 3.91 9.07e-05

Carrying Capacity:
 Estimate   SE    z  P(>|z|)
     1.63 0.36 4.52 6.16e-06

Detection:
            Estimate    SE     z  P(>|z|)
(Intercept)   -1.882 0.341 -5.51 3.58e-08
date          -0.627 0.121 -5.17 2.33e-07
time          -0.174 0.108 -1.61 1.08e-01

AIC: 526.22 

> ranef(fm4)
Error: could not find function "tp"


> (fm4 <- pcountOpen(~woody, ~1, ~1, ~date+time, alfl.umf, K=30,
+                    dynamics="ricker"))

Call:
pcountOpen(lambdaformula = ~woody, gammaformula = ~1, omegaformula = ~1, 
    pformula = ~date + time, data = alfl.umf, K = 30, dynamics = "ricker")

Abundance:
            Estimate    SE    z  P(>|z|)
(Intercept)    1.044 0.291 3.58 3.38e-04
woody          0.446 0.115 3.89 9.98e-05

Growth Rate:
 Estimate    SE    z P(>|z|)
    0.456 0.273 1.67  0.0943

Carrying Capacity:
 Estimate    SE    z  P(>|z|)
     1.67 0.357 4.69 2.74e-06

Detection:
            Estimate    SE     z  P(>|z|)
(Intercept)   -1.891 0.370 -5.11 3.19e-07
date          -0.633 0.124 -5.10 3.43e-07
time          -0.175 0.110 -1.59 1.12e-01

AIC: 527.0265 

> re = ranef(fm4)
Error: could not find function "tp"


Thanks in advance for help!

Drew

messages.author: 10e17346e14a0eac
messages.subject: Re: ranef and pcountOpen
parts:
Hi Drew,

Thank you for catching this!  I messed up and didn't update ranef with the new dynamics models when we added them.  Important note: currently, when immigration is TRUE and dynamics is "autoreg" or "trend", ranef doesn't give an error message, but also leaves out the immigration effects.  If estimated iota is substantial, this could have a big effect on the predictions.

I believe I have fixed these problems in the unmarked code.  Hopefully, a new version of unmarked will be posted soon with these fixes.  In the meantime, don't use ranef with the new dynamics models in pcountOpen (unmarked version 0.10.6).

Jeff
